data.one_liner: Removes markdown syntax from a string
data.what_it_does: This package strips markdown formatting from a string, leaving plain text. It supports paragraphs, links, images, lists, code blocks, inline code, emphasis, headers, and HTML tags.
use_when: Need plain text from markdown for display or logging
Converting markdown to plain text for search indexing
avoid_when: Rendering rich text with markdown features
strengths: Cross-platform support (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: Does not support tables or HTML tags fully
